notes.note: Tsatas continued his good run of scoring with a 22 possession game. If he keeps scoring like this he will be one to possibly hold through his bye as good bench cover.
Another great score from Tsatas as he continues to show that he is a talent and a good SuperCoach scorer. 25 disposals and he led the Bombers in clearances with 7.
Tsatas came back into the side after missing 4 games. He showed that he should have been in before now with his 26 disposals including 9 contested possessions.
Tsatas had a great game in the VFL and must be considered for this week's game by Essendon.
Elijah didn't deliver what those that brought him in this week were hoping for but with his BE he is certainly still of value to your side. He still had 18 disposals so he should be ok.
This is two solid scores now for Tsatas and a BE of -49. He will be amongst the most traded in.
